locations.note: With Peter away, Miles guards a snowbound Manhattan over Christmas as Roxxon and the Underground go to war.
Miles's new home: the Underground and Roxxon fight in its streets, Krieger rigs the Nuform reactor at Roxxon Plaza to destroy Harlem, and Rio and Aaron evacuate it while Miles stops Phin.
In the post-credits scene Miles leaves the award he won with Phin on top of Trinity Church, in her memory.

routes.name: Miles Morales
routes.note: From the battle for Harlem to Miles's tribute to Phin on top of Trinity Church.
